document_title: Manage your request types and ticket categories
content:
Learn about the four main ITSM categories in Jira Service Management: service requests, incidents, problems, and changes.
Tickets are the requests raised in your service space either by customers, or by agents on your customer's behalf. You can use ITSM categories and request types to organize the requests your customers submit.
